claims_paraphrased: Thinking helps in an intermediate difficulty regime
Both modes lose exact accuracy on larger puzzles
Measured thinking tokens can decline near failure
Providing a Hanoi algorithm does not reliably restore exhaustive execution
original.relevant_methods: 25 samples per puzzle, up to 64k generation tokens; Hanoi validity rather than move optimality

claims_paraphrased: Token ceilings and voluntary abbreviation can confound failure
Compact generating functions can succeed when move lists fail
rebuttal.cautions: v2 corrects an earlier output-size assumption; its program experiment is preliminary and underpowered. This experiment does not independently adjudicate river-crossing impossibility claims.

sampling_note: Use Qwen thinking recommendation temperature=.6/top_p=.95/top_k=20 in BOTH modes to isolate the template switch; OFF is therefore not its separately optimized decoding recipe.
